caseName: Arizona Free Enterprise Club's Freedom Club PAC v. Bennett

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1060.] Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted. Motion of petitioners for divided argument denied.
